summary: Full backend + frontend test of Hard Curves. Backend: 21 pytest cases (auth 401 on 11 routes, per-user isolation, PR logic incl. first-log/incomplete/equal-load, date validation incl 2026-02-30/future/1900, photo ext/size/isolation/admin fetch/soft delete, owner 403/200 + regex-escape search, role in PATCH ignored, export, reset) all pass. Frontend (ticket sign-in): Home widgets, session persists on reload, Training plan edit (rename plan/day, toggle chips, remove/add day, persist after reload, empty-name validation), Log workout (load plan day, load/reps/RIR, tick -> rest timer, +15/-15/Skip, Rest over + dismiss, completed switch, Clear, PR dialog with Download (PNG downloaded) & Share), Measurements add/filter/delete with confirm/cancel + future date blocked, Progress stats + like-for-like bar chart + volume chart + Share PR from records, Photos upload x2, select 2 -> compare (49 days between, that day's measurements), delete, Profile name/units (cm/kg <-> in/lb verified on measurements & workout volume), export JSON, reset with confirm, sign out -> /sign-in, member /owner -> Access refused, owner dashboard stats/search/empty state/athlete detail/photo viewer/back link, long-press logo -> /sign-in?redirect_url=/owner with owner tagline, mobile 390px bottom nav + rest timer not overlapping nav. One real mobile UX bug found (rest timer covers Save button).

minor.issue: Type check is extension-only (no magic-byte/content sniffing) and whole file is read into memory before the 10MB check. Any bytes named .png are accepted and served as image/png.
Soft delete only (object stays in storage, record kept with is_deleted) while UI says 'The photo will be removed for good' — privacy copy mismatch for private body photos.

ui_bugs.issue: When rest timer is active and user scrolls to bottom, the fixed timer (top=684px) covers the lower part of the Save workout button (button 643-699px). main has pb-32 which is not enough for bottom nav + timer. Add extra bottom padding (e.g. pb-56) on log page while timer is visible.

issues: Bar chart Y axis does not start at 0 (43.5cm baseline) which exaggerates differences for bars; consider domain starting at 0 or using a line chart
Future date is blocked by native browser max-date validation bubble (form submit) rather than the app's toast; works, but inconsistent with Log workout which shows a toast

action_items: Mobile: add extra bottom padding on /log while rest timer is visible so Save workout button is not covered
Photo delete/reset: either hard-delete storage object or change copy 'removed for good'
Optional: content sniff uploaded images; stream size check
Optional: zero-based Y axis for measurement bar chart; fix '1 sets' pluralization
critical_code_review_comments: server.py validate_date allows today+1 (UTC tolerance) while frontend uses local today — OK but document it
Brand long-press uses pointerleave to cancel; layout shift while Clerk widget mounts can cancel the press (first attempt during load did not navigate, second after load worked)
TrainingPage DayEditor key falls back to index for new days without id — can cause input state mix-ups when removing a new day before another new day
List endpoints return up to 2000-5000 docs without pagination (fine for MVP)
test_credentials: test_credentials.md was empty; added the 3 Clerk test users (athlete=member, athlete2=member, owner=admin). Sign in via ticket only.
seed_data_creation: athlete2 (Ben) was reset multiple times; final state: reset to defaults (units metric, display name Ben, default plan). Alex data untouched (only viewed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with `-n 0` (pytest.ini enables xdist; tests reset athlete2 at session start so must run serially). Tickets are one-time: regenerate via clerk_tokens.py tickets for each browser session. Server/browser clock is 2026-10-26.
